title: PUSH RGU Hub
tagline:
Notices to your fingertips.
Powered By Push Protocol (prev. EPNS)
description:
It scrapes our university digital notice board and pushes the new updates to the students mobiles.

It saves hell lot of time and addresses the major problem that young people now-a-days face...

**LAZINESS**

Another way of seeing it is, I'm trying to introduce web3 to the young generation in a innovative way which motivates them to dig deep, explore the space and be the pioneers of the next revolution.
how_its_made:
I've ran into some challenges while trying to PUSH notifications from backend.
I used *@epnsproject/backend-sdk-staging* module but couldn't make it.

Later, after surfing some more time, I've got another module named: *@pushprotocol/restapi*
That solved my quest!
